units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: The term of a fixed-term contract is resumed by concluding a supplementary agreement to it.
units.label: Point 5.2 Art. 12.1 · “The term of a fixed-term contract is resumed by concluding a…”

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 6. If a state servant fails to return to state service after the period of suspension expires, the contract with that servant may be terminated according to the procedure provided for by the federal law on the relevant type of state service.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 7. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 10-ФЗ of 14.02.2024.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 8. The period of suspension of state service due to the circumstances provided for by point 2 of this Article is included in the length of service of the state service that was suspended, to the extent that it does not exceed the duration of military service under mobilization, service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation under mobilization, military service under a contract concluded during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or voluntary assistance in carrying out tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 8 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 12.1. Procedure for Suspending and Resuming State Service
units.text: 9. Federal laws on the types of state service may provide for other special rules for suspending the respective type of state service.
units.label: Point 9 Art. 12.1

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.label: Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: 1. In accordance with federal laws on the types of state service, citizens serving in federal state service are assigned class ranks, diplomatic ranks, military ranks and special ranks.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: In accordance with the federal law on the relevant type of state service, class ranks are established for citizens serving in the state civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 13 · “In accordance with the federal law on the relevant type of…”

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: 2. The general conditions for assigning and retaining class ranks, diplomatic ranks, military ranks and special ranks are:
units.label: Point 2 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: the successive assignment of a class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank after the prescribed period of holding a particular class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank has elapsed following its initial assignment;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 13 · “the successive assignment of a class rank, diplomatic rank,…”

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: the assignment to a state servant of a class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank corresponding to the federal state service position held;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 13 · “the assignment to a state servant of a class rank, diplomatic…”

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: the early assignment, as an incentive, of a class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank, or assignment of a class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank one level above the class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank provided for the federal state service position held, in accordance with the federal law on the relevant type of state service;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 13 · “the early assignment, as an incentive, of a class rank,…”

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: the retention of an assigned class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank upon release from the federal state service position held or dismissal from federal state service.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 13 · “the retention of an assigned class rank, diplomatic rank,…”

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: An assigned class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank may be revoked by a court decision.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 13 · “An assigned class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or…”

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: 3. When a state servant is transferred from one type of state service to another, the previously assigned class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank, as well as the period for which the respective rank was held, is taken into account when assigning a class rank, diplomatic rank, military rank or special rank in the new type of state service, in accordance with federal laws on the types of state service and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: 4. The equivalence between class ranks, diplomatic ranks, military ranks and special ranks is established by a Presidential decree of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Class Ranks, Diplomatic Ranks, Military Ranks and Special Ranks
units.text: 5. Class ranks in the state civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are assigned with due regard to the provisions of this Article, according to the procedure established by normative legal acts of the respective constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 14. Length (Total Duration) of State Service. Personal Data of State Servants
units.text: Article 14. Length (Total Duration) of State Service. Personal Data of State Servants
units.label: Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Length (Total Duration) of State Service. Personal Data of State Servants
units.text: 1. The length (total duration) of state service is determined in accordance with federal laws on the types of state service, on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have served in state service and their families, and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Length (Total Duration) of State Service. Personal Data of State Servants
units.text: 2. In accordance with federal laws on the types of state service, on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have served in state service and their families, and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, the length (total duration) of one type of state service includes periods of other types of state service, as well as periods of holding state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal offices held on a permanent basis, and municipal service positions.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Length (Total Duration) of State Service. Personal Data of State Servants
units.text: 3. State servants’ personal data and information on their professional official activities and length (total duration) of state service are entered in state servants’ personal files and personnel records. Those files and records are maintained and stored in accordance with federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Length (Total Duration) of State Service. Personal Data of State Servants
units.text: 4. The form and procedure for maintaining, registering and storing documents confirming state servants’ professional official activities are established by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Length (Total Duration) of State Service. Personal Data of State Servants
units.text: 5. Personal data entered in state servants’ personal files and personnel records constitute information access to which is restricted in accordance with federal laws. There is an obligation to maintain the confidentiality of those personal data and ensure their security during processing. In the cases established by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, those personal data are classified as information constituting a state secret.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 15. Registers of State Servants
units.text: Article 15. Registers of State Servants
units.label: Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Registers of State Servants
units.text: 1. Registers of state servants, compiled on the basis of state servants’ personal data, are maintained, including on electronic media, in a federal state body, a public authority of a federal territory and a state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Registers of State Servants
units.text: 2. Information entered in the register of federal state servants in a federal state body or a public authority of a federal territory, and in registers of state servants of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, is classified, in the cases established by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, as information constituting a state secret, and in other cases as confidential information.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Registers of State Servants
units.text: 3–7. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 419-ФЗ of 28.12.2010.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 15 · “3–7. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 419-ФЗ of 28.12.2010.”

units.locator: Chapter 3. STATE SERVICE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
units.text: Chapter 3. STATE SERVICE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
units.label: Chapter 3. STATE SERVICE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM

units.locator: Article 16. State Service Management
units.text: Article 16. State Service Management
units.label: Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. State Service Management
units.text: The state service management system is established at the federal level and at the level of constituent entities of the Russian Federation to coordinate the activities of state bodies in addressing entry into state service, formation of the personnel reserve, performance and termination of state service, use of the personnel reserve to fill state service positions, professional education and additional professional education of state servants, and rotation of state servants, as well as to exercise oversight from outside the respective department of compliance by state bodies with federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on state service.
units.label: Art. 16 · text

units.locator: Article 17. Personnel Reserve for Filling State Service Positions
units.text: Article 17. Personnel Reserve for Filling State Service Positions
units.label: Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Personnel Reserve for Filling State Service Positions
units.text: A federal personnel reserve, a personnel reserve in a federal state body, a personnel reserve in a public authority of a federal territory, a personnel reserve of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and a personnel reserve in a state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are established for filling state service positions.
units.label: Art. 17 · text

units.locator: Article 18. Funding of State Service and Programs for Its Reform and Development
units.text: Article 18. Funding of State Service and Programs for Its Reform and Development
units.label: Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Funding of State Service and Programs for Its Reform and Development
units.text: 1. Federal state service and state civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are funded, respectively, from the federal budget, the budget of a federal territory and the budget of the respective constituent entity of the Russian Federation, according to the procedure established by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Funding of State Service and Programs for Its Reform and Development
units.text: 2. The state service system is improved through the implementation of federal programs for the reform and development of federal state service and corresponding programs of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18.1. Military Service in the Russian Federation by Foreign Citizens and Stateless Persons
units.text: Article 18.1. Military Service in the Russian Federation by Foreign Citizens and Stateless Persons
units.label: Art. 18.1

units.locator: Article 18.1. Military Service in the Russian Federation by Foreign Citizens and Stateless Persons
units.text: 1. In the Russian Federation, provision is made, in accordance with a federal law, for foreign citizens and stateless persons to enter military service under a contract and to perform military service.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 18.1

units.locator: Article 18.1. Military Service in the Russian Federation by Foreign Citizens and Stateless Persons
units.text: 2. The provisions of this Federal Law defining the legal foundations of state service of the Russian Federation apply to those citizens and persons.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 18.1
